porch.name: Chapel Porch
porch.desc: The chapel door is shut. A verse is cut into the wood.

aisle.name: The Aisle
aisle.desc: Black candles burn without warming anything. A vestry door is east.

vestry.name: Vestry
vestry.desc: Robes rot on their hooks. A thick red vial stands on the vestment chest.

altar.name: The Altar
altar.desc: The altar cloth is ash. A silver mace lies where the book should be.

sanctum.name: Sanctum
sanctum.desc: The sanctum has no windows. The priest is already facing you.

echo_riddle.desc: The door asks: 'I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?'
echo_riddle.success_msg: Your answer comes back, and the door opens.
echo_riddle.hint: One word. Shout in a stone room and listen.
